_comment: Thresholds for scripts/check_production_slo.py (run by .github/workflows/health-check.yml). ONE owner for every number: the script contains no threshold literal. Chosen from a 14-day replay of real GitHub Actions history (see the PR that introduced this file; reproduce with `python scripts/check_production_slo.py --backtest-days 14`). Code freshness and data freshness are separate named results on purpose: a green board does not excuse an undeployed fix, and a fresh deploy does not excuse a stale board.

codeFreshness._comment: Age of the OLDEST main commit that is not in the deployed SHA AND touches a path deploy.yml does not ignore (a docs-only/data-only commit starts no deploy by design; data reaches production via the refresh dispatch and is judged by dataFreshness below).

deployFailures._comment: Breach only when BOTH hold: consecutive failed Deploy Production runs >= maxConsecutiveFailures AND the last success is older than maxHoursSinceSuccessWithUndeployed (or absent), while deploy-relevant commits are undeployed. Failure streaks that recover within hours are normal operation.

refreshPipeline._comment: Normal gaps between successful scheduled-refresh runs are 8-12 h (docs/ops/SCRAPE_CADENCE_MEASUREMENT_2026-11-09.md); 21-day replay: median 7.1 h, max 11.6 h.

dataFreshness._comment: data_freshness.roster_age_hours has no number here on purpose: the box decides rosterState with src/api/roster_freshness.py against league_registry.SCORING_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_HOURS (6 h, published as rosterMaxAgeHours), the same rule the N-team trade engine refuses on. Healthy roster age peaks near 2.1 h (docs/ops/ROSTER_FRESHNESS_MEASUREMENT_2026-11-18.md).

alerting._comment: Box-side owner-alert health, read from /api/status (src/utils/owner_alerts.py, src/api/ops_alerts.py). maxConsecutiveDeliveryFailures: attempted deliveries that failed in a row in the running process (a box with no channel configured attempts nothing). maxAlertSweepAgeHours: the daily dynasty-signal-alerts sweep (15:00 UTC, up to 5 min jitter) carries every ops, source-staleness and backup-coverage alert; 30 h = one missed day plus slack, so one late run does not page.
